experiments.scope: Organizer-executed replay of one committed SHA-256/32 collision pair (yudduy, hash-smash #227, credited). The program recomputes the second block from CV1 = C_32(IV, M0) and counts mismatches against the embedded Fig. 6 signed rows (A and E steps -4..22, W0..W31); every trial returns the same pair and the organizer checks the full-collision event.
experiments.hypothesis: The truncated Fig. 6 route of Li, Liu, Wang, Shi (CRYPTO 2026) yields complete-message sha256-r32 collisions: the committed pair collides under the organizer digest and its second block follows every Fig. 6 signed row (0 mismatches). This is corroboration of the route on one pair; it makes no inference about attack cost, success probability or rates.
